unauthenticatedNote: When no credentials exist, agy acp still answers initialize and session/new (advertising authMethods), and rejects unauthenticated API calls with 'Authentication required. Please visit the URL to log in:' / unauthenticatedAuthResult. In headless workers, pass --dangerously-skip-permissions or pre-authenticate via 'agy acp --login'.
